scope: All 19 retained outgoing paid request files enumerated in prior audit plus unchanged effective instructions. Not training-data holdout or all historic generation.

methodology.comparison: All maximal contiguous normalized word spans; every >=8-word span and all per-file longest ties retained. 8 words is the requested reporting threshold, not an acceptance threshold; no stopword, boilerplate, Scripture, or schema matches are dropped.
methodology.normalization: JSON parsed once into all string values and keys; each leaf scanned independently. Literal backslash n/r/t sequences treated as spaces. Unicode letters only, numbers/punctuation split words, NFKC + casefold, ae/oe ligature fold. Original artifacts unmodified.
methodology.locations: Zero-based half-open word and Unicode character offsets inside exact source and decoded target string leaf; JSONPath identifies leaf. Source sections identify embedded Scripture vs Henry introductory material vs Henry specific argument.
methodology.limits: Lexical overlap, not paraphrase/semantic plagiarism detector. No cross-leaf concatenation. Any embedded serialized JSON remains one decoded text leaf; no generated answer file was read. Retained assistant continuations already present in outgoing paid requests are included as historical exposure.
